messages:
tess: Noticed two more OOMs in the prod-runtime pool this morning (both ~03:12 UTC). Same kernel trace, same compaction window. Opening this thread to track concrete follow-ups from the postmortem and the dark-launch plan.

lee: Thanks. Quick ask: can we dark-launch a compaction concurrency cap + instant abort when host mem < 10%? That would be low-risk and should prevent the tail cases.

omar: I can wire the abort + cap behind a flag. Will also add a metric for compaction.aborted_by_mem. Planning to push a small agent change. ETA: 12h to get flag + tests.

mira: I'll own the RCA and data collection. Plan is: collect heapshots before/during/after compaction, histogram diffs, and a run of jemalloc stats during the repro. Also want to check for pinned spans in the allocator. ETA: 4 working days for initial report.

sre-bot: Created ticket INF-3180 "prod-runtime OOMs: compaction-related memory spikes" assigned to omar,mira. Priority: P1. Link: https://tickets/internal/INF-3180

tess: Owners and short timeline:
- Omar: feature flag + abort threshold rollout (dark launch) / due 12h
- Mira: profiling + RCA / due 4d
- Lee: incident telemetry dashboard (compaction rate, aborts, free_pages.p10) / due 24h
- Tess: coordinate canary & capacity if needed / due 24h

omar: Example repro commands I'm using on staging:
```bash
# run the mini repro harness with heap sampling
./run_repro --workers 8 --qps 60 --duration 45m --heap-snapshot=interval:60s
# collect jemalloc stats during the run
ssh repro-node "cat /proc/$$/maps && jeprof --show_bytes ./service jeprof.out"
```
I'll also gather `pmap` snapshots.

lee: For telemetry, I'll add these metrics (to be backfilled 60 days):
- runtime.kv.compact.count
- runtime.kv.compact.concurrent
- runtime.kv.compact.aborted_by_mem
- runtime.kv.free_pages.p10/p50/p90
- runtime.kv.live_pages.shard_p95
And a dashboard with compactions overlaid on host free memory.

omar: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/CR/10222 (feature flag + abort). Includes unit tests and a rollout README.

mira: Also checking recent merges: there was a compaction heuristic tweak three weeks ago (CR-987). Will include that in regression analysis.

tess: Rollout plan for the dark launch (omar):
1) dark launch behind flag, no traffic change (collect metrics only) - 0-12h
2) canary on 2 hosts with 0.5% traffic and abort threshold - monitor 24h
3) escalate to 5% if stable, then 25%
Rollback: flip flag off, drain compactions in-flight, revert capacity if needed.

lee: Also recommend a short-term alert: fire when compaction.aborted_by_mem > 5 in 5m or host free mem < 8% during compaction window.

omar: Status update: feature-flag branch pushed, unit tests green, waiting on staging quota for longer repro runs. ETA to push dark metrics: 6h.

mira: Status update: starting heapshot collection tonight across 3 prod replicas; will post initial graphs by EOD tomorrow. Blocker: need clearer mapping of shard->host in logs; @lee can you add a tag to the compaction logs?

lee: Will add shard_id to compaction logs and to the telemetry label set. ETA 4h.

omsre-bot: (system) scheduled job: backfill runtime.kv.compact.* metrics for last 60 days. Job id: backfill-2025-03-01

tess: Action item: schedule a short findings demo after initial RCA (owners: mira + omar). Target date: 2025-01-20.

omar: Note on repro parity: our staging repro accelerates compaction frequency; will normalize graphs by compactions/hour to compare to prod.

mira: For the RCA I'll include checks for: allocator regressions (jemalloc upgrade), kernel memory limits, and any recent config changes to compaction heuristics. Also will look for fragmentation patterns in the allocator stats.

tess: Thanks. Please keep daily brevity updates here until INF-3180 is resolved. If you hit a blocker, @me directly.

omar: Daily status (update): dark metrics enabled, abort counter metric is coming through. Waiting on staging long-run permission.

mira: Daily status (update): first heapshots collected from prod, initial diff shows small rise in small-chunk allocations post-compaction. Will analyze further.

lee: Daily status (update): dashboard draft posted: https://grafana.internal/d/runtime/compaction-telemetry - will add alerts after metrics finish backfilling.

tess: Closing note: if RCA shows a single hot path, plan to ship a targeted fix in 3 business days after RCA. If it's allocator-level, we may need a rollback or allocator tweak.

(End of thread)
